patchNotes: Adds draggable red/green/blue rotation rings to Animation Studio; clicking joints now selects them. Corrects the steering preview axis and connection point. Fixes sparse Loop poses fading toward stock and holds Tweak poses outside authored keys. Existing variations, inherited contact locks, presets and settings are retained. 484 automated checks and compiled compatibility audits passed; the new visuals and riding playback still require in-game confirmation.
